title: Gherkin: revision-aware result publication (local-first / cloud backstop)
description:
## Behavior to specify

Kanbus tasks may update frequently. Publication is based on the logical task revision, not whichever worker finishes last.

Pattern: a local worker may claim first (near-zero marginal compute). If the task stays unprocessed beyond a threshold (example: 15 minutes), a cloud worker becomes eligible. An obsolete render must not overwrite a newer revision.

The cloud execution environment is not the queue or the source of truth. Git remains durable history.

## Acceptance

Gherkin for revision compare-and-publish, stale-result reject, and eligibility after local-claim timeout. Dual-runtime later.
